parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID.
